## Logline

A writer who had left the theatre for many years had discovered that she was about to begin in the name of others, and had tried to stop her performance, but found in one page of missing manuscripts that she, the mentor and the theatre manager had only remembered the part of the truth that best served them.

## Themes and Audience Experience

- Theme: Memory automatically defends itself; only by tearing down facts, contributions and authorizations can one see the real boundaries of co-creation.
- Sub-theme: Recognition of the contribution of others will not make their work disappear, but will blur all borders.
- Emotional path: Stunning and retrieving the word eclectic eclectic inversion of evidence damaged both sides redistribution restraint and reconciliation.
- End experience: No win-win judgement, a more accurate and crowded signature form to complete the emotional fall.

## Seven-Episode Structure

### The name on the poster.

Lin Xia Go back to the theater and pick up what's left of it.Mei Zhong Main signature.Gao Rui Take out the performance authorization. The Blue Book is missing a key page.Lin Xia And decided to stop the premiere.

### Episode 2 Who wrote Act 2

Lin Xia Prove in rehearsal that you are familiar with each action and pause;Mei Zhong The old tape also says, “The second act is given to Nacchan”.Gao Rui In the last few days, she has been able to get a message from her “Don't Sign”. For the first time, the parties broke up openly.

### Episode 3, 13th edition

Lin Xia and Mu Qiao(b) Collating materials, distinguishing each text contribution, performance authorization and promotion of the signature. The old version proved she had a lot of rewrites, but she also stayed.Gao Rui. Formal disputes entered the external process and the first countdown continued.

### Episode 4, First Sitting down.

Both parties are mediated before the Court.Lin Xia It's about being erased.Gao Rui Only the theatre survives, and mediation does not bear fruit. The suspension of tickets puts both actors and staff at a direct cost.Zhou Zhou They were asked to return to the theater and actually restore the process.

### Episode 5, The Clock of No Walking.

People returned the original version of the rehearsal log and found that no one was able to restore the whole play on their own. Page 47, where the disappearance occurred in the old stage clocks, clearly recorded the different contributions of the three.

### Episode 6 " each adverse fact "

During the trial, the materials of both parties testified to each other and weakened each other.Lin Xia It's not like you're going to sign it.Gao Rui The initiative to simplify posters is acknowledged. For the first time, they discussed how to keep the work going, not how to lose.

### Episode 7 "Signatures Not Periods"

Both parties signed clear contributions and performance arrangements, and re-produced posters and programmes. The premiere is resumed. The old clock of the stage is moving again and the exact and imperfect signature replaces the past lacuna.

## Continuity Bible

### Character Appearance and Wardrobe

- `CH-001 Lin Xia`Black shoulder-to-shoulder, silver frame glasses, light ash windshirts, ink and blue shirts, black straight pants; with red brushes. Episode 1-2 wore the same set; Episode 3-4 replaced the grey short coat; Episode 5 rehearsed the sleeves; Episode 6-7 was the Tibetan suit jacket. The blue ink on the right-hand index finger in the third round of Episode 1 will remain in place until the end of the day.
- `CH-002 Gao Rui`Short hair, dark t-shirts and brown jackets with theatre work cards on the chest. The work cards in series 1-3 are always in place; the work cards in series 4 are taken off when entering an outside location; they are re-enacted after the play in series 5; and the black shirt is changed on the night of the opening of episode 7 but the same work card is kept.
- `CH-003 Zhou Zhou`• Short ponytails, rehearsings of rice T-shirts, black sweatpants, red soft-soft shoes; official performances to change blue skirts. Yellow is always posted on the top right corner of the cover of the script.
- `CH-004 He Lan`: Silver gray hair short, dark green needle knit coat, neck with soft ruler, silver pin on right hand. In the search for missing pages in Episode 5, the sleeves were covered with white dust, and in Episode 7, shallow marks were still visible.
- `CH-005 Mu Qiao`: Short curly hair, white shirt, dark gray vest, black hard-shell folder. The black record confirms the facts and the pencil record infers that the two may not be used intermingled.
- `CH-006 Judge Han`: Clean work and dress, sound smooth. The 4th, 6th and 7th clusters are identical and do not add dramatic personal accessories.

### Locations

- `LOC-001 Echo Theater Rehearsal`Black box space, front line mirrors, old white line on the ground; stage clocks are usually placed behind right. A new red, blue, yellow, three-colour tape was added to volume 5 to distinguish versions.
- `LOC-002 Theater Hall.`: The entrance is facing the poster wall, the ticket counter on the left, and the hall on the right. Original poster 1 by Lin Xia The white paper was placed, the 4th episode was covered with ashes and the 7th episode was replaced with a new poster.
- `LOC-003 Backstage storage/proper storage`Metal racks, old costumes, dust sheets and wooden boxes. The old stage clock was located at the bottom shelf and episode 5 was moved to the central desk.
- `LOC-004 Gao Rui Office`: A narrow long table with a first-time countdown card on the wall and a file cabinet by year. The countdown period was changed from seven days to a pause, and in episode 7 it was restored to “Tonight”.
- `LOC-005 External program space`Corridors, mediation rooms, pre-trial areas and court scenes remain light and restrained from using exaggerating towers or spotlights.
